unifiedTCI-StateTypeIndicates the unified TCI states type the UE is configured for this LTM candidate configuration. The value separate means this LTM candidate configuration is configured with ltm-DL-OrJointTCI-StateToAddModList for DL TCI states and ltm-UL-TCI-StateToAddModList for UL TCI states. The value joint means this LTM candidate configuration is configured with ltm-DL-OrJointTCI-StateToAddModList for joint TCI states for UL and DL operation. The network always configures this field.
